        mlp_y = self.mlp(norm2_y)
        resid2_y = mlp_y + resid1_y
        return resid2_y

class Layer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = TransformerBlock()

    def forward(self, x):
        block_y = self.block(x)
        return block_y

class GqaAttention2(nn.Module):
    """gqa_attention: d_model=384, heads=16, kv_heads=16, head_dim=24, bias=true, causal=false, window=0, qk_norm=false, flash=true"""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(384, 384, bias=True)
        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(384, 384, bias=True)
        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(384, 384, bias=True)
        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(384, 384, bias=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        q_proj_y = self.q_proj(x)
        k_proj_y = self.k_proj(x)
        v_proj_y = self.v_proj(x)
        B, T, _d2 = q_proj_y.shape
        q_heads_y = q_proj_y.view(B, T, 16, 24).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        B, T, _d2 = k_proj_y.shape
        k_heads_y = k_proj_y.view(B, T, 16, 24).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        B, T, _d2 = v_proj_y.shape
        v_heads_y = v_proj_y.view(B, T, 16, 24).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        attn_y = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q_heads_y, k_heads_y, v_heads_y, is_causal=False)
        B, _d1, T, _d3 = attn_y.shape
        o_merge_y = attn_y.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, T, 384)
        o_proj_y = self.o_proj(o_merge_y)
        return o_proj_y

class DenseMlp2(nn.Module):
    """dense_mlp: d_model=384, hidden=1536, act=gelu, bias=true"""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.up = nn.Linear(384, 1536, bias=True)
        self.down = nn.Linear(1536, 384, bias=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        up_y = self.up(x)
        act_y = F.gelu(up_y)
        down_y = self.down(act_y)
        return down_y

class TransformerBlock2(nn.Module):
    """transformer_block: d_model=384, heads=16, kv_heads=16, head_dim=24, ffn_hidden=1536, attention=gqa, q_lora=0, kv_lora=0, nope_dim=0, rope_dim=0, v_dim=0, norm=layernorm, norm_bias=true, post_norm=false, mlp=dense, experts=0, top_k=1, expert_hidden=0, shared_experts=0, router_bias=false, act=gelu, attn_bias=true, mlp_bias=true, qk_norm=false, causal=false, window=0"""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(384, eps=0.00001, bias=True)
        self.attn = GqaAttention2()
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(384, eps=0.00001, bias=True)
        self.mlp = DenseMlp2()

    def forward(self, x):
        norm1_y = self.norm1(x)
        attn_y = self.attn(norm1_y)
        resid1_y = attn_y + x
        norm2_y = self.norm2(resid1_y)
        mlp_y = self.mlp(norm2_y)
        resid2_y = mlp_y + resid1_y
        return resid2_y

class Layer2(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = TransformerBlock2()

    def forward(self, x):
        block_y = self.block(x)
        return block_y

class Net(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.patchify = nn.Linear(588, 1280, bias=True)
        self.context = nn.ModuleList([Layer() for _ in range(32)])
        self.context_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1280, eps=0.000001, bias=True)
        self.to_pred = nn.Linear(1280, 384, bias=True)
        self.mask_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, 384))
        self.predictor = nn.ModuleList([Layer2() for _ in range(12)])
        self.pred_norm = nn.LayerNorm(384, eps=0.000001, bias=True)
        self.to_embed = nn.Linear(384, 1280, bias=True)
        self.target_patchify = nn.Linear(588, 1280, bias=True)
        self.target = nn.ModuleList([Layer() for _ in range(32)])
        self.target_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1280, eps=0.000001, bias=True)

    def forward(self, ids):
        patchify_y = self.patchify(ids)
        context_x = patchify_y
        for layer in self.context:
            context_x = layer(context_x)
        context_norm_y = self.context_norm(context_x)
        to_pred_y = self.to_pred(context_norm_y)
        mask_token_y = self.mask_token.expand(ids.shape[0], 256, -1)
        with_masks_y = to_pred_y + mask_token_y
        predictor_x = with_masks_y
        for layer in self.predictor:
            predictor_x = layer(predictor_x)
        pred_norm_y = self.pred_norm(predictor_x)
        to_embed_y = self.to_embed(pred_norm_y)
        target_patchify_y = self.target_patchify(ids)
        target_x = target_patchify_y
        for layer in self.target:
            target_x = layer(target_x)
        target_norm_y = self.target_norm(target_x)
        return target_norm_y
